offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests (up to 10 results); each result above 10 adds $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG（按请求计费，无订阅、无最低消费）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（URLs、page contents、highlights、structured outputs、AI summary）
offerings.note: Base price includes up to 10 results; Enterprise offers up to 1,000 results per search and custom indexes.

offerings.name: Deep Search (type: deep-lite / deep / deep-reasoning)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG，/search 的 type 参数档位，最高公开基础档为 deep-reasoning $15/1k
offerings.output_type: 带引用的多步研究结构化输出
offerings.note: deep-lite ~4s; deep 4–15s; deep-reasoning 12–40s. Additional results and AI summaries cost same as standard search.

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)
offerings.output_type: 带引用的 LLM 答案

offerings.name: Contents (/contents)
offerings.pricing: $1 / 1k pages, per content type; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.note: 每个 content type（text/highlights/summary）单独计费。

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests; each result above 10 adds $1 / 1k results; AI summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web

offerings.name: Agent API
offerings.pricing: $0.012–$1.00 / fixed-effort run (minimal $0.012, low $0.025, medium $0.10, high $0.50, xhigh $1.00); metered: $0.10/ACU, search tool calls $0.005/search; auto 默认 $5 cap, beta max $20 cap
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 固定 effort 按次，或计量计费
offerings.output_type: Async deep research, list building, and enrichment
offerings.note: auto is the default metered mode. Contact enrichment: email $0.02, phone $0.07. Connect provider calls billed additionally (e.g. Fiber.ai $0.02/credit).
